title: Hybrid LFP + LIC — flattened transient delivered to LFP
description: The DC-DC control law routes content above the LPF cutoff (≈0.32 Hz, τ=0.5 s) to the lithium-ion capacitor; the LFP pack sees only the smoothed average. Cell voltage stays in the plateau, electrode stress drops, expected cycle life extends ~25 % per the proposal §A.
